messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added **Deal name** under **Reproduce a game**. Names now save and restore with progress.

Fixed valid pasted saves being rejected because their JSON fields appeared in a different order. Older saves remain supported.

Type checking, 148 unit/static tests, and all 83 browser tests pass. Changed files pass formatting; the full formatting check flags 12 pre-existing files.
